scope: Independent visual PDF layout review only. No theorem audit, compilation, or source editing performed by this reviewer.

initial_review.method: Reviewed three supplied contact sheets and each of the 24 supplied Poppler page renderings at individual-page readable scale using view_image.

findings.description: The thematic module reference table leaves only its final CoordinateBasisChange row on a new page, followed by the closing paragraph. This produces an orphaned table continuation page.
findings.suggested_repair: Reduce local table row spacing without reducing type size or move a meaningful row group together.
findings.resolution: The local table row-spacing adjustment keeps all thematic rows and the closing paragraph on final PDF page23, with readable text and no clipping or overlap.

findings.description: Inline multi-token Lean expressions use the URL-style leanname macro, which suppresses spaces. The rendered text merges names and arguments (for example partialA m K becomes partialAmK, and BudgetProfile.beta T w becomes BudgetProfile.betaTw).
findings.suggested_repair: Use a separate space-preserving inline-code macro for expressions, retaining the breakable identifier macro for single long names.
findings.resolution: The separate leanexpr macro preserves spaces in inline Lean expressions. Independently rechecked IsUnit C on page4, the diagonal model/parameter/applications/lambda on pages17–19, and lake build on page22. Long single identifiers remain intact.

initial_positive_observations: All inspected text and displayed equations remain inside page margins.
No text overlap, clipped declaration name, black-square replacement, or missing mathematical glyph observed.
Ceiling, summation, norm, subscript, superscript and Greek symbols on the new diagonal pages render legibly.
Cover, contents, section hierarchy, headers and footers are consistent.

final_review.method: Initial all-page visual inspection followed by independent final inspection of every changed rendering and neighboring pages. SHA-256 comparison confirms all other final page images match the initially inspected pages.

final_observations: No clipped or overlapping text observed in the final inspected renderings.
No missing glyph, malformed equation, or cut declaration name observed.
All theorem interfaces and code examples remain readable.
The new diagonal chapter retains consistent typography, equations, page margins and section hierarchy.
The final thematic reference table has no orphaned row or continuation page.
Headers, footers and page numbering remain consistent.
